# Results report (auto-generated by main.py)

All numbers below come from the SYNTHETIC dataset and were produced by this run. They show that the pipeline works; they do not measure real-world predictive performance.

XGBoost installed for this run: **True**

## 1. Purchase-likelihood prediction (supervised extension)

Base purchase rate: 40.0%. Accuracy of always predicting 'not purchased' would be about 60.0%; compare models with ROC-AUC, PR-AUC and Brier score (lower is better; `brier_baseline` of the base rate is in the CSV).

## 5. Decision Tree classification of garments into clusters

Held-out accuracy 1.000, macro-F1 1.000, depth 6, 10 leaves. Clusters are defined by the same aggregated attributes the tree sees, so very high accuracy is expected: the tree is an interpretable, deployable replica of the clustering, not independent evidence that the clusters are 'real'.
